description: Open a session, execute a list of actions in one call, and return a compact step report plus the final screenshot (optionally a screenshot per step). Use it to run a whole test flow: sign in, open a drawer, submit a form — then inspect the report.

asserts.description: Assertions evaluated after the last step (same schema as session_assert checks)

engine.description: Chromium (default) records video; webkit is a Safari-flavoured approximation

record.description: Record a webm video of the flow (and a gif when ffmpeg is available)

screenshots.description: Save final only (default), every step, or none

steps.description: Action objects, same schema as session_act action

name: run_flow
